note: Clayton County Conservation primitive campground 5.5 mi NW of Elkader, across the Turkey River from the Big Spring trout hatchery: three numbered sites in a grassy clearing between Chariot Road and the river, with canoe access. Generators are prohibited. The county closes it when the river nears flood stage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 (+$4 processing fee), 3 primitive sites, online booking via MyCountyParks with 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums; unreserved sites day-of. Pit toilet. Waterfront stays not waterfront (conflicting evidence on site 3). Fit unclear.
flags: WATERFRONT (stays not waterfront; unsure, so not raised): the Turkey River here is about 30-32 m wide on NAIP (riverfront-sized by the ~30 m rule). The three sites share one grassy clearing between Chariot Rd and the south bank; on 2024-era NAIP the clearing's north edge looks open to the bank about 8-10 m away, but the county's own site aerial puts site 3 (the nearest) behind a belt of bank trees, and sites 1-2 sit further back toward the road under trees. With the two images disagreeing and the per-site positions only approximate, the call stays down. If a site visit or a newer photo shows site 3 open to the water, riverview (or riverfront) would be the lead.
